newsitem.title: THAILAND: N.T.S Steel says Q1 loss due weak economy.
newsitem.headline: N.T.S Steel says Q1 loss due weak economy.

text.p: N.T.S Steel Groups Plc said on Monday it posted a 222.6 million baht loss in the first quarter against a 959 million baht profit a year ago as its business was hurt by the sluggish Thai economy and foreign exchange losses.
"(The first quarter loss) was caused by higher cost and the continuously low price of steel due to sluggish economy," the company said in a filing to the Stock Exchange of Thailand.
The company reported a 23 million baht foreign exchange loss and higher loan financing cost for the quarter.
NTS rose 0.20 baht to 2.70 during the Monday morning session.
